name: Encrypted Rune
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: While you were helping me out, this rune was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the rogue trainer Solm. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
narrative.objectives: Read the Encrypted Rune and speak to Solm Hargrin in Coldridge Valley.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Anyway, as you start peekin' around Coldridge you'll probably have need of training at some point. You just come back to me whenever you feel you need it and I'll teach you what I know--a trick here, a maneuver there. You know, the stuff that keeps you alive and makin' a little extra coin.

Keep an eye out on our gnomish friends too... they kinda got the short end of the stick what with Gnomeregan being... destroyed. They'll need our help to feel welcome.
narrative.requestItemsText:
You made it! Great!

We've got an influx of activity lately, so I'm glad to count another of the Ironforge clan among our numbers. Too many of us are lookin' to the arcane, and divine for my own tastes. Nothin' against them and their beliefs, but there's nothing like a cold blade in your hand and a shadow to keep you from the light, know what I mean?
